desc: DownHill Ball is an endless-descent arcade game where your ball never stops falling downhill. Control the descent, weave through tricky obstacles, and rely on quick reflexes as the pace escalates run after run. The endless-runner structure means the only goal that matters is distance: stay focused, plan each dodge a beat ahead, and travel as far as possible without crashing.

tips: Look two or three obstacles ahead instead of the ball itself.

faqs.question: What is DownHill Ball?
faqs.answer: DownHill Ball is a free browser arcade game where you control a constantly descending ball down an endless slope, dodging obstacles while the speed keeps increasing.

faqs.question: How do you play DownHill Ball?
faqs.answer: Move the ball left or right with simple taps to bypass obstacles. The key is planning each move before the obstacle arrives, because the ball accelerates the whole way down.

faqs.question: Does DownHill Ball ever end?
faqs.answer: No — DownHill Ball is an endless runner. The run only ends when you crash, and your goal is to beat your own best distance each time.
